file.description: CSV file to import. Required. Allowed types: csv, txt (mimes:csv,txt). Max size 2048 KB. Must include a header row with a `code` column (or `carrier` + `carrier_service_code` columns) plus a `shipping_method_id` (authoritative) and/or `shipping_method_name` (fallback) column. Leave both shipping-method columns blank on a row to REMOVE that mapping.
